featured_reviews.name: binoy varghese
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased this stained-glass star, and it has truly exceeded my expectations. The craftsmanship is excellent — the glass panels have vibrant shades of blue and green that catch the light beautifully, giving a warm, festive glow to the entire corner of my décor. The metal framing feels sturdy and well-finished, adding to its premium look.

What I appreciate most is how effortlessly it enhances the ambiance. Whether lit or unlit, it stands out as a stunning decorative piece. The hanging chain is strong and the overall build gives a very handcrafted, artisanal feel.

It has become a perfect focal point above my nativity setup, adding just the right touch of elegance and Christmas charm. Completely worth the purchase — highly recommended for anyone looking to elevate their festive decorations!

I also want to appreciate the staff / owner  who assisted me before the purchase. She took the time to call me, patiently show a live video demo of the star, and explain the details clearly. Her  courteous approach and willingness to help gave me complete confidence in placing the order. It’s rare to experience such personalised customer service these days, and it made a big difference.

featured_reviews.name: Rafiya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

The pen is still visible in the product images, and I have screenshots of the original description showing it was included when I purchased. Very disappointing experience and poor customer service. I expected either the missing item to be sent or some accountability for the misleading listing.

I had not so google experience with gift and giggles, I had ordered 55 pieces of bag and bottle, first they were supposed to deliver me the order by 1st attaching the picture of their record, for which they were trying to convince that means dispatching date , when their own notes says delivery date as 1st , I have been working in retail from 15 years I don’t know when dispatch is same as delivery.

I had event on 5th they delivered me on 4th , sharing picture of the condition.
Yes I asked them to pack but why their own person said ma’am please dont take paper bags it will increase the size of order and it will be difficult to ship.

May be they are good for in mumbai .. but would not recommend them at all for outside Mumbai order ..

Out of 55 20 pack were torn n such bad condition.

Tomorrow I have event and today I have to figure out how not be ashamed in front of my guests.

And Sunny had audacity to say buy gift bags.

featured_reviews.name: puneet dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would like to sincerely thank your company for the beautiful return gifts provided for our daughter’s birthday celebration. The gifts were of excellent quality, thoughtfully designed, and perfectly suitable for children.
All the kids absolutely loved them, and many parents also appreciated the creativity and usefulness of the items. The packaging, timely delivery, and overall presentation were impressive and reflected your professionalism and commitment to quality.
It truly added extra joy to the celebration and made the occasion even more memorable. We are very happy with your service and would definitely recommend your company to others. Looking forward to working with you again in the future.
Thank you once again!

featured_reviews.name: harshita talati
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered my daughter’s 5th birthday return gifts from Gifts and Giggles, and it was a wonderful experience! 😊

They were very patient in showing a wide range of options and suggested ideas based on the kids’ age, which made choosing much easier.

The team is very responsive and even accommodated a last-minute request, which I really appreciated.

What stood out the most was their end-to-end delivery support, it was completely hassle-free. The packaging was neat and well done, saving us a lot of time.

They are truly trustworthy and reliable. Definitely recommend them for a smooth and stress-free gifting experience!

featured_reviews.name: poonam shevale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly wonderful experience with Gifts and Giggles! I ordered Children’s Day gifts for kids, and I was extremely impressed with both the quality and presentation. Each gift was thoughtfully packed, vibrant, and exactly as I had imagined. 🎁✨

What really stood out to me was the level of care and personal touch in their service. The owner himself personally came to deliver the gifts, ensuring everything was handled with great attention and care. That kind of commitment and customer service is rare to find these days and is truly commendable. 👏

From this experience, I can confidently say that Gifts and Giggles will be my go-to store for all future gifting occasions — be it birthdays, festivals, or special celebrations. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for creative, high-quality gifts with exceptional service! 💐🎉

featured_reviews.review_text:

The owner takes great effort and enthusiasm in showcasing all possible combinations based on your budget.
Lovely external packaging, with neatness and finesse. Each creative, customized placard was placed, with precise attention to detail.
The overall finish and quality was appreciated by everyone.
Keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Tulika Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered return gifts from GIFTS and Giggles for our son's 10th birthday, and all the gifts were beautifully packed and promptly delivered to our doorstep. featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved their decoration work! The hampers were beautifully packed with elegant red and gold wrapping. Very neat, classy, and perfectly done. Highly recommended!

I added two stars for the good owners. The guy present in the store is an extremely cranky and irritable person. Last year, I purchased a large beautiful seated Ganesha with led lighting and 5 brass Hindu idols. Gave them Rs.25k worth of business in one order. At the time of selling, the cranky man had said the metallic gold paint on the Ganesha's garments will not get tarnished. But it started turning black in just 6 months. When I visited him today, I showed him pictures of the blackened paint and asked him the remedy. I had not uttered the word guarantee or warranty, I simply and calmly asked him what's the solution. And he started rudely telling me in a loud voice that there is no warranty or guarantee for any items in the store. I again asked him what's the solution and I understand there's nothing like a warranty for the art items. But he should offer a solution since he had claimed the paint will not fade or get tarnished. He again started almost shouting that I will never give warranty or guarantee. If you want to get it repainted, you have to pay the artists fees. I said ok what would be the approximate fees. Again screamed, How will I know? Artist is not available now. When he will be back, you have to pay whatever he asks for. And he did this ruckus in front of other customers in the shop potentially jeopardizing future sales.

I told him I will not shop there again left the store as I didn't want to traumatize my daughter who was with me. Even as we were leaving, the guy said, your choice don't come here again.

Apart from this negative experience with the cranky man, the store has beautiful artworks and the owners are decent people. Last year, they delivered the Ganesha to our home carefully so that we don't need to worry about damaging it while taking it home. So two stars to the owners. But zero for the cranky store guy.
